text.en: Deforestation, pollution, overuse and climate change are four names for one kind of damage.

modelCorrection.en: They are different pressures. Deforestation removes habitat, pollution adds harmful substances, overuse takes resources faster than they recover, and climate change shifts temperature and rainfall.

text.en: A forest with many species has no risk of any disease.

modelCorrection.en: Where biodiversity is rich, the risk of tick-borne disease is generally lower. It lowers the risk, and it does not remove it.

text.en: Growing several crop varieties can lower the risk of crop failure, but it cannot promise that every plant survives.
Changes in temperature and rainfall can affect which species are able to live in a place.
